workflow.what_to_do: Write the outcome, population, geography, period and unit of analysis before downloading anything.
workflow.evidence_to_save: One-sentence research question; target geography and years

workflow.what_to_do: Prefer the agency that collected or legally maintains the raw records; use international databases for harmonization and comparison.
workflow.evidence_to_save: Originating agency and canonical landing page

workflow.what_to_do: Record the survey wave, table number, file name, data version and publication date. Do not rely on homepage alone.
workflow.evidence_to_save: Direct URL, file name, checksum if practical, access date

workflow.what_to_do: Download questionnaire, codebook, enumerator manual, sampling design, weights, classifications, metadata and geographic crosswalks.
Record whether the file is open, registration-based, restricted, paid or subject to redistribution limits.
workflow.evidence_to_save: License/terms, access permission and any required citation

workflow.what_to_do: Keep the unmodified original file separately from cleaned copies; do not overwrite raw files.
workflow.evidence_to_save: Read-only raw file and SHA-256 checksum

workflow.what_to_do: Count records/variables, inspect missing values, duplicates, codes, ranges, weights and keys.
Determine whether rows represent people, households, firms, schools, incidents, district-years or time-series points.
workflow.evidence_to_save: Data dictionary with unit of observation

workflow.what_to_do: Read sampling design, strata, clusters, weights, response rate and survey domain definitions before calculating estimates.
workflow.evidence_to_save: Method note and analysis weight/strata/PSU fields

workflow.what_to_do: Separate calendar year, financial year, survey fieldwork period, release date and estimate year.
Use official district/province codes and versioned boundary files; document splits, merges and renamed units.
Use consistent variable names, units, dates, categories, currency, inflation basis and missing-value handling in derived files.
Compare key values with a second credible source and investigate differences in methods, revisions or definitions.
Check disclosure risk for microdata, rare categories, tiny geographies and sensitive personal records; avoid reidentification.
Create derived metrics only after provenance, comparability, sample design, units and missingness have been checked.
Cite source file/version, period, geography, method and retrieval date; distinguish official data from modeled estimates and third-party compilation.
workflow.evidence_to_save: Citation record, code, outputs and limitations

download_queue.formats: Excel and PDF tables; key findings report

download_queue.formats: Excel tables, quarterly releases, annual series, visualization and press releases

download_queue.resource_family: PBS monthly Consumer Price Index (CPI) releases and annexures
download_queue.formats: Monthly PDF release, Excel annexures, interactive trend chart and methodology

catalog.formats_access: Interactive datasets, charts, downloadable files and statistical profiles
catalog.period_coverage: Long-run annual/monthly series depending on topic
catalog.research_uses: Trade, investment, commodity dependence, maritime transport and development finance
catalog.caveats: Check whether data are UNCTAD estimates or reproduced official sources, and note the series release.

catalog.title: World Integrated Trade Solution (WITS)
catalog.formats_access: Trade, tariff and non-tariff indicator tools; downloads/access vary
catalog.research_uses: Tariff protection, import structure, exports, trade partners and product-level competitiveness
catalog.caveats: A platform integrating multiple data providers; check source/HS code and access conditions.

catalog.title: World Trade Organization Statistics portal
catalog.formats_access: Interactive tables and downloadable trade/tariff series
catalog.research_uses: Goods/services trade, tariffs, trade policy and market access
catalog.caveats: Check reporting year, aggregation and tariff measurement method.

catalog.title: FAO AQUASTAT
catalog.formats_access: Country water profiles, water statistics, maps and datasets
catalog.research_uses: Water withdrawal, irrigation, resources, agricultural water productivity and water stress
catalog.caveats: Water-use estimates are periodically updated and may rely on different national reporting vintages.

catalog.title: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) Pakistan
catalog.formats_access: Interactive charts, Excel downloads and MICS/survey report links
catalog.period_coverage: National estimates over time; survey-based rounds and annual global updates
catalog.geographic_detail: Households, schools and health-care facilities; rural/urban and wealth inequalities where supported
catalog.research_uses: Access to drinking water, sanitation, hygiene and service levels
catalog.caveats: JMP harmonizes many national surveys; the modeled series may differ from a single PBS table.

catalog.title: WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) — Pakistan WASH series
catalog.formats_access: Downloadable XLSX/CSV indicator series and country estimates for drinking water, sanitation and hygiene; school and healthcare-facility WASH series where available.
catalog.period_coverage: Historical comparable series; reference years vary by indicator
catalog.geographic_detail: National, urban/rural and service-setting breakdowns where available
catalog.research_uses: WASH access, service ladders, inequality, school facilities and health-care facility WASH
catalog.caveats: These are internationally harmonized/modelled estimates using multiple sources; cite JMP methodology and keep distinct from a raw household survey tabulation.

catalog.title: PASTIC Pakistani scientific and technical journals directory
catalog.formats_access: Searchable journal catalogue/metadata
catalog.research_uses: Find Pakistani journals for economics, health, education, social sciences and technology
catalog.caveats: Journal listing/recognition is not a guarantee of quality of every paper; verify article-level methods.

catalog.title: HEC Pakistan Research Repository
catalog.formats_access: Thesis/dissertation records and full texts where available
catalog.research_uses: Find local empirical studies, historical tables, survey appendices and research on underserved topics
catalog.caveats: Thesis quality, accessible data and methods vary; use theses as leads and cite carefully.

catalog.title: IBA School of Economics and Social Sciences data archive
catalog.formats_access: Curated links to PBS PSLM/HIES, LFS and PDS microdata
catalog.period_coverage: Includes PSLM 2019–20, HIES 2018–19, LFS 2020–21 and PDS 2020 links
catalog.research_uses: One-page launch point for high-value household/labour microdata and documentation
catalog.caveats: IBA links onward to original sources; use the original PBS page/version when available.

catalog.title: PACRA sector research and rating reports
catalog.formats_access: Credit-rating reports, sector studies and corporate analysis
catalog.period_coverage: Ratings and sector reports updated by issue
catalog.research_uses: Corporate financial risk, leverage, debt servicing and sector outlook
catalog.caveats: Coverage is limited to rated/covered entities; rated-company samples are not representative of all businesses.

catalog.title: VIS Credit Rating Company research and ratings
catalog.formats_access: Credit rating reports, sector analysis and press releases
catalog.research_uses: Company/sector credit quality, financial performance and risk signals
catalog.caveats: Interpret rating scale and date; not a comprehensive official company-statistics database.

catalog.title: Trading Economics Pakistan indicators
catalog.formats_access: Interactive indicators, charts, CSV/API services depending on plan
catalog.period_coverage: Current and historical series; update frequency varies
catalog.research_uses: Quick trend scans of CPI, GDP, rates, unemployment, trade and debt
catalog.caveats: Secondary aggregation; check named upstream provider and data definition before citing.

catalog.title: CEIC Pakistan macroeconomic database
catalog.formats_access: Time-series database, charts, exports and paid data services
catalog.research_uses: Historical series when a source website is difficult to navigate
catalog.caveats: Subscription may be required; store source notes and verify against official series where possible.

catalog.title: Policy Research & Advisory Council (PRAC) data infographics
catalog.formats_access: Data infographics with Excel-sheet downloads, charts and monthly briefs
catalog.period_coverage: Monthly/periodic series for trade, remittances, inflation, power generation, LSM and GDP
catalog.research_uses: Quick Excel starting point for time-series and concise economic visuals
catalog.caveats: Secondary compilation; compare series and dates against PBS/SBP/Finance Division before citing.

catalog.title: Pakistan Institute of Development Economics (PIDE) research library
catalog.formats_access: Working papers, policy briefs, books, research reports and presentations
catalog.research_uses: Taxation, productivity, public sector, urbanization, labour, poverty and macroeconomic policy analysis
catalog.caveats: Individual papers vary by data quality and peer review; open the methodology and references.

catalog.title: Annual Status of Education Report (ASER) Pakistan
catalog.formats_access: Annual reports, survey findings, tables and selected district/province data
catalog.geographic_detail: District/province and rural/urban depending on ASER round
catalog.research_uses: Foundational reading and arithmetic, school participation, household schooling and learning gaps
catalog.caveats: Citizen-led assessment with its own sampling/design; don't equate directly with national official learning assessments.

catalog.title: Centre for Economic Research in Pakistan (CERP)
catalog.formats_access: Research papers, working papers, field experiments and impact evaluations
catalog.geographic_detail: Pakistan study sites and sampled populations
catalog.research_uses: Policy programme impact, education, labour, poverty and service delivery evaluation
catalog.caveats: Local experimental findings may not generalize nationally; inspect design, power and replication resources.

catalog.title: Social Policy and Development Centre (SPDC) publications
catalog.formats_access: Research papers, policy reports, public-finance and social-sector analyses
catalog.research_uses: Budget analysis, provincial inequality, social spending, education, health, gender and poverty
catalog.caveats: Analytical work often uses official data; preserve the original data vintage and model assumptions.

catalog.title: FAFEN election observation and parliamentary monitoring reports
catalog.formats_access: Election reports, observation data and parliamentary monitoring publications
catalog.research_uses: Electoral integrity, turnout, participation, polling observations and legislative activity
catalog.caveats: Observation coverage is not necessarily a full census of all polling places; read sampling/coverage statement.

catalog.title: PILDAT democracy and institutional scorecards
catalog.formats_access: Scorecards, reports, surveys and policy papers
catalog.research_uses: Parliamentary performance, democracy, elections, public perception and governance
catalog.caveats: Composite scores and expert assessments involve stated rubrics; use methodology and source material.

catalog.title: Pakistan Business Council research and trade statistics
catalog.formats_access: Downloadable trade workbooks/briefs, sector studies and industry reports
catalog.period_coverage: Monthly / FY comparisons and longer sector research
catalog.research_uses: Export competitiveness, trade in goods/services, industrial policy and market concentration
catalog.caveats: Often a compiled/analytical layer using official data; reconcile period and currency with PBS/SBP.

catalog.title: Pakistan Institute of Labour Education and Research (PILER)
catalog.formats_access: Labour reports, wage/working-condition studies, rights publications and research
catalog.research_uses: Informal economy, gendered labour, industrial relations, workers' rights and social protection
catalog.caveats: Check sample, respondent type and whether a statistic comes from an independent survey or official series.

catalog.title: PPRI Pakistan Data Observatory — open public data downloads
catalog.publisher: Pakistan Provincial Reform Institute (PPRI), based on cited official sources
catalog.formats_access: Machine-readable CSV datasets compiled from PBS, Finance Division and SBP publications; catalog describes census, HIES, prices, macroeconomic/debt and digital-access extracts.
catalog.period_coverage: Current curated release; check dataset-specific metadata and source vintages
catalog.research_uses: Quick analysis, prototypes, charting, data-pipeline testing and reproducible notebooks
catalog.caveats: Curated/derived rather than original data; cite both PPRI and original source, verify values against source tables, and inspect license/version notes.

catalog.title: Data Darbar — machine-readable Pakistan data warehouse
catalog.formats_access: Open catalog plus queryable DuckDB/Parquet warehouse of census, household/labour surveys, detailed trade, national accounts, federal budget and SBP series.
catalog.period_coverage: Coverage follows underlying source vintages; catalogue updates should be checked
catalog.geographic_detail: National, province, district/tehsil depending on series
catalog.research_uses: Bulk analytical exploration, merges, cross-dataset comparisons and GIS-linked indicators
catalog.caveats: An independent cleaned/assembled layer rather than the source authority. Verify provenance, transformations, dropped rows and geographic crosswalks before publication.

catalog.title: Open Data Pakistan catalogue
catalog.formats_access: Dataset records with downloads, source metadata and formats depending on dataset
catalog.geographic_detail: Pakistan and province/district if source provides
catalog.research_uses: Locate secondary copies/cleanings of surveys, government tables and public datasets
catalog.caveats: Confirm whether uploader is the source owner; check license, update, completeness and official source link.

catalog.title: Data for Development Pakistan — dataset catalogue
catalog.formats_access: Topic-based survey and dataset discovery, PDFs and linked datasets
catalog.period_coverage: Includes PDHS rounds, Maternal Mortality Survey 2019, Agriculture Census and Economic Census entries
catalog.research_uses: Find health, education, gender, agriculture, nutrition, housing, communication and WASH data in one place
catalog.caveats: Treat it as a discovery catalogue; the original publisher and access permissions control each file.

catalog.title: Our World in Data — Pakistan-related charts and source data
catalog.formats_access: Interactive charts, CSV downloads and source documentation
catalog.research_uses: Fast exploratory comparison for health, poverty, population, education, food, energy and climate
catalog.caveats: OWID is a documentation/visualization layer; click through to original source and account for revisions.

catalog.title: Data Darbar sources and methodology
catalog.formats_access: Source-file catalogue, field definitions, limitations and data documentation
catalog.period_coverage: Warehouse source snapshots vary by dataset
catalog.research_uses: Identify original files, provenance, derived variables and limitations before using a ready-made dataset
catalog.caveats: Not the official producer; validate transformations and licensing at source.

catalog.title: Data Darbar open Pakistan data catalogue
catalog.formats_access: Downloadable CSV/Parquet datasets; queryable DuckDB warehouse; source-file index
catalog.period_coverage: Census, labour/household surveys, trade, national accounts, budgets and SBP series
catalog.geographic_detail: District/tehsil and national, according to underlying source
catalog.research_uses: Rapid access to cleaned official data, district panel tables, trade, budgets and custom joins
catalog.caveats: Derived/cleaned layer; document the upstream source/version and verify critical values against PBS/Finance/SBP.

catalog.title: Tabadlab research library
catalog.formats_access: Policy reports, research briefs and public-service/digital-policy analysis
catalog.research_uses: Governance, service delivery, health, digital transformation, technology and economic reform
catalog.caveats: Synthesis and policy recommendations rather than primary national data in most outputs.

catalog.title: Google Dataset Search
catalog.formats_access: Search index with external links to datasets
catalog.research_uses: Discover forgotten ministry, university, NGO, GIS and survey datasets
catalog.caveats: Not a data custodian; source owner/license and update status must be verified.

catalog.title: DataReportal — Pakistan digital reports
catalog.formats_access: Country reports, downloadable slides/figures and linked data sources
catalog.geographic_detail: Pakistan national and selected digital audiences/platforms
catalog.research_uses: Internet, social media, mobile connections and digital behaviour trends
catalog.caveats: Methodology can combine sources and platform advertising audiences; avoid equating ad reach with active unique users.

catalog.title: Google Scholar
catalog.formats_access: Search index for articles, theses, books and working papers
catalog.research_uses: Locate research papers and trace references to primary datasets
catalog.caveats: Search ranking is not a quality score; confirm peer review and version of record.

catalog.title: Human Rights Commission of Pakistan annual and thematic reports
catalog.formats_access: Annual reports, human rights reports and thematic publications
catalog.research_uses: Violence, civil liberties, labour rights, gender, minorities, justice and social conditions
catalog.caveats: Counts from monitoring/reporting networks may not be exhaustive administrative totals.

catalog.title: Center for Research and Security Studies reports
catalog.formats_access: Periodic security reports, incident statistics and analytical publications
catalog.geographic_detail: National, province and districts where coded
catalog.research_uses: Terrorism, violent incidents, fatalities and changes in security trends
catalog.caveats: Methodology and media-monitoring coverage may differ from government and international incident datasets.

catalog.title: Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies (PICSS)
catalog.formats_access: Incident reports, security trend tables and analysis
catalog.research_uses: Conflict event trends, militant activity and security-related outcomes
catalog.caveats: Secondary monitoring dataset; validate any high-impact claim with multiple sources.

catalog.title: Pakistan Institute for Peace Studies (PIPS) security publications
catalog.formats_access: Annual security reports, conflict monitoring, journals and research reports
catalog.geographic_detail: Pakistan with province/region/incident analysis by report
catalog.research_uses: Militancy, terrorism, extremism, conflict and peacebuilding
catalog.caveats: Counts are publication-specific; reconcile incident inclusion rules across providers.

catalog.title: Ipsos Pakistan research
catalog.formats_access: Survey findings, market reports, charts and commissioned research
catalog.research_uses: Consumer confidence, brand/market trends, public opinion and digital behaviour
catalog.caveats: Detailed data may be proprietary or paywalled; check whether results are nationally representative.

catalog.title: Gallup Pakistan poll and survey archive
catalog.formats_access: Poll findings, charts, survey reports and selected downloadable material
catalog.geographic_detail: National or target sample as defined by survey
catalog.research_uses: Public attitudes, consumer sentiment, politics, social issues and economic perceptions
catalog.caveats: Read methodology, sample frame, mode, question wording, weighting and margin of error before interpreting.

catalog.title: Sustainable Development Policy Institute (SDPI) research archive
catalog.formats_access: Reports, policy briefs, conference papers and research publications
catalog.research_uses: Climate, energy, food security, trade, governance, poverty and social development
catalog.caveats: Source data and peer-review status vary by document.

catalog.title: Dawn — economy, policy and data reporting
catalog.formats_access: Articles, graphics and linked official reports
catalog.research_uses: Discover policy changes, controversies, official data releases and explanatory reporting
catalog.caveats: Use for discovery/context; source important numerical claims to official data/reports.

catalog.title: Reuters — Pakistan economy and business reporting
catalog.formats_access: News articles and market reporting
catalog.research_uses: Discover major debt, IMF, investment, commodity and business events
catalog.caveats: Secondary reporting; valuable independent context but verify data at source for quantitative analysis.

catalog.title: Business Recorder — markets, fiscal and economy
catalog.formats_access: News, market tables, analysis and reports
catalog.research_uses: Find policy announcements, commodity prices, company news and economic context
catalog.caveats: Not a primary national statistics collector; validate reported values against PBS/SBP/FBR.

catalog.title: Bloomberg economics and Pakistan market coverage
catalog.formats_access: News, charts and financial market data, some paid
catalog.research_uses: Market-oriented evidence, bond/FX/investment context and business developments
catalog.caveats: Paywalls and proprietary market series may limit reuse; do not treat as raw public microdata.
